summary: Organogenesis Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an at-the-market equity offering program. On August 6, 2026, it entered into a Sales Agreement with BTIG, LLC and Citizens JMP Securities, LLC, allowing the sale of up to $75 million of Class A common stock under an existing S-3 shelf. Agents earn a 3.0% commission. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special-situation event.
